model: Exact vector leaky modes of a three-layer cylindrical trench guide (experimentos/vectorial_claude/vector_layers.py via trinchera_vectorial.solve), HE11 only. Ideal step profile; no scattering, absorption, bend or fabrication roughness.
question: How wide must the trench be for the ideal leakage floor of HE11 to stay at or below 10 % of the verified state of the art (0.06 dB/cm at 1550 nm, T26 rule R1)?
pre_commit_checks: One solve at t = 12 um reproduced the registered value (n_eff 1.442189333, leakage 0.0440442 dB/cm) to check the solver and its run time (2.4 min). No other width was computed before this commitment.
decision_rule: t_min = smallest width (log-linear interpolation) with leakage <= 0.006 dB/cm. The H1-SOTA coupon uses the next whole micrometre above t_min plus 1 um of margin; if t_min is not reached within 20 um, H1-SOTA is declared infeasible for this index contrast.
heldout_policy: Deterministic prediction registered before any fabrication or measurement; the prediction itself is what the blind cutback (T14) will test.
